name: Armored Swiftness
body:
Armored Swiftness (Ex)
Source Chronicle of Legends pg. 6
In time, the heaviest armor can become like a second skin. A slayer with this talent can move at full speed in heavy armor. In addition, the maximum Dexterity bonus of heavy armor the slayer wears increases by 1 for every 6 class levels he has. A slayer must have the armored marauder slayer talent to select this talent.
